signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Track reports, receive updates, and manage civic issues.
signIn.adminNote: Admin credentials are issued by CivicWatch management.

category.title: What kind of issue are you reporting?
category.subtitle: This decides which Lagos State agency receives your report first.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Drainage, flooding, air and water pollution

sanitation.title: Sanitation
sanitation.description: Waste collection, illegal dumping, public hygiene

safety.title: Personal Safety / GBV
safety.description: Handled on a restricted, confidential channel

description.title: Describe the incident
description.subtitle: Be specific about what is happening and the nearest landmark.
description.shortPlaceholder: Summarise the issue in a few words
description.shortHelper: A one-line summary, e.g. "Blocked drainage causing flooding".

guidance.duration: Include how long the issue has existed.
guidance.affected: Mention if people, homes or businesses are already affected.
guidance.privacy: Do not include other people's personal details.

location.title: Where is this happening?
location.subtitle: An accurate location lets the assigned agency dispatch to the right street.
location.gpsTitle: Use current GPS location in Lagos
location.gpsSubtitle: Coordinates are attached to the report, never to your identity.
location.addressPlaceholder: e.g. 14 Allen Avenue, near Computer Village
location.addressHelper: Street name and number, or the closest junction.

media.title: Add photos or video
media.subtitle: Optional, but evidence raises the urgency score and speeds up verification.
media.dropSubtitle: JPG, PNG, HEIC, MP4 · location metadata is stripped

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.anonymousHelp: Your identity will be hidden from the public dashboard.
privacy.lockedHelp: Automatically enabled for Personal Safety / GBV reports.
privacy.noPii: No name, phone number or email is attached to this report.
privacy.encrypted: Submission is encrypted in transit, and photo location metadata is stripped.

success.title: Report Submitted Successfully
success.body: Your report has been securely submitted. Response teams will review shortly.

nextSteps.title: What happens next
nextSteps.step2: You can expect an initial review within {slaHours} hours.
nextSteps.step3: You will be notified when the status changes.
nextSteps.escalation: If nothing changes within {escalationHours} hours, you can escalate.

issues.title: Civic Issues Near You
issues.subtitle: Open reports across {region}, routed to the responsible agency.

reports.title: My Reports
reports.subtitle: Reports filed from this account.
reports.signInPrompt: Sign in to view your reports and receive status updates.
reports.empty: You haven't filed any reports yet.

howItWorks.title: How CivicWatch Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Reports are triaged and routed to the responsible Lagos State agency.
howItWorks.step1Body: Pick a category, describe the issue, drop a location and attach photos or video.
howItWorks.step2Body: Every report returns an ID such as LGS-84920 that works without an account.
howItWorks.step3Body: Received → AI triage → agency assigned → resolution.
howItWorks.step4Body: Personal Safety / GBV reports are handled on a restricted channel and never appear in the public feed.
howItWorks.emergency: Emergency? Call {primary} or {secondary} as well as filing a report.

offline.banner: You're offline. Reports will sync when you reconnect.

errors.network: Network error. Please check your connection.
errors.auth: You need to sign in first.
errors.permission: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
